title: Changes to Check Listing Prerequisite API in v202312
breadcrumb: Changes to Check Listing Prerequisite API in v202312
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-01-11
html:
What is changing?

Check Listing Prerequisites has a new version of v202312, updated from v202309. With this change, fields in the response body are now static. We hope this change improves developer experience and productivity.

What are the affected markets?

This change is applicable to all markets.

Who is affected?

All seller types can benefit from this change.

Which version are these changes for?

This change is only for v202312, which is available for the Check Listing Prerequisite API. Upgrade to v202312 to benefit from a better development experience from a more RESTful API.

Required Actions

We recommend adopting this new version and updating your code with the refactored fields. Static fields simplifies logic on API response parsing, which will lead to a smaller number of issues that would otherwise happen if the response has dynamic fields. API Reference.
